secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key powering the financial brain (server-side replies in /api/jeff). Without it the app runs in scripted mode. Get it from https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys.

secrets.name: ADMIN_EMAILS
secrets.description: Comma-separated emails of people who can open the Admin screen to add companies and make team codes, e.g. you@yourcompany.com. Sign up with that email first.

secrets.name: PLAID_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Plaid client ID, for read-only bank connections. From https://dashboard.plaid.com/developers/keys

secrets.name: PLAID_SECRET
secrets.description: Plaid secret for the environment in PLAID_ENV (the Sandbox secret while testing). Same page as the client ID.

secrets.name: PLAID_ENV
secrets.description: sandbox while testing (fake banks, free), production for real banks once Plaid approves the app.

secrets.name: PLAID_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Optional. This app's address plus /api/plaid/webhook, e.g. https://your-app/api/plaid/webhook. Lets new transactions arrive on their own.
